_doc: Twelve things that happen TO a zone. An incident is a timed state on the territory record: it changes what spawns, what people say, which job frames can fire and what a shop charges. They start on a clock, on something you did, or on a faction's grip crossing a line. `hours` null means it runs until something resolves it. Read by js/incidents.js.

incidents.name: A raid is coming
incidents.blurb: there is a band on the road and the gate is not manned

onExpire.rumour: the gate at {zone} did not hold

incidents.name: Short rations
incidents.blurb: nothing has come up the road in a week

onExpire.rumour: {zone} went hungry and remembers who did not come

incidents.name: The dead are up
incidents.blurb: something got dug and the rest have taken it badly

onExpire.rumour: the cairns at {zone} settled on their own. Probably.

incidents.name: A grudge
incidents.blurb: something out there has your measure and has told its friends

incidents.name: A feud
incidents.blurb: two of them want the same ground and have stopped talking about it

onExpire.rumour: the feud in {zone} burned itself out

incidents.name: A bloom
incidents.blurb: everything green has come up at once

incidents.name: A collapse
incidents.blurb: a gallery came down and took the way in with it

incidents.name: Ash fall
incidents.blurb: the sky is the colour of a floor and everyone is indoors

incidents.name: Fair day
incidents.blurb: there is a fair on and everything is cheap

onExpire.rumour: the fair at {zone} has packed up

incidents.name: Shut gates
incidents.blurb: the gates are shut and they are trading over the wall

incidents.name: The bounty has gone up
incidents.blurb: something has survived three hunts and the price on it has tripled

incidents.name: The road is out
incidents.blurb: the direct road is washed through and the long way is worse
